title: The 95-5 Rule
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated (footer 2025). About 95% of potential B2B buyers are out of market at any time; purchase-cycle examples (computers about every 4 years, banks about every 5); work with the Ehrenberg-Bass Institute; 96% of surveyed B2B marketers expected the main effect within two weeks, which the page calls a myth.

title: The B2B Effectiveness Code
publisher: LinkedIn B2B Institute, with WARC and Lions
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated (footer 2025). Study of B2B creativity and effectiveness from 2010 to 2021; ladder of effects from response trigger and lead generator to sale closer, fame maker, brand builder and strategic asset.

title: Predictions 2027: AI Takes Over Business Buying, But Humans Retain Control (Barry Vasudevan)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dated 28 Oct 2026. Prediction: agentic buying in 75% of B2B purchases by 2027; buyers double human interactions to validate AI recommendations; 82% of buyers said their purchase included AI functionality (Forrester 2026 survey); buying teams grew from 8 to 13 (no sample stated). The page also carries promotional 'Ask AI' prompts, which were ignored.

title: Targeting options for LinkedIn Ads
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. Minimum audience of 300 member accounts per ad set; company and contact list uploads (Matched Audiences); company, job function and seniority attributes; reach for some options including Matched Audiences may be limited in the EEA and Switzerland; Member Groups not available there.

title: LinkedIn buyer groups
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated days before the check. Buyer groups audience built by LinkedIn models from profile and relationship signals; 56 product categories; no A/B testing; predictive audiences disabled when on; saved buyer group audiences shareable across ad accounts but company list segments are not.

title: Create an event audience (Matched Audiences)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. Retarget people by engagement with a LinkedIn Event: selected to attend, registered and attended, registered but did not attend, engaged but did not register; audience must match at least 300 members; Page and ad account roles needed.

title: Lead Gen Forms Privacy Policy
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated about 11 months before the check. Privacy policy URL required; describe how leads will be used; up to five disclosure checkboxes, optional or required; no default consent checkbox for EU members since 21 April 2020.

title: Data collection and retention for Lead Gen Forms
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. Sponsored, Event and Candidate interest leads kept 365 days; Company Page, product and LinkedIn Landing Page leads 90 days; advertisers may not request sensitive data; use of form data subject to the member's agreement and applicable law.

title: LinkedIn conversion attribution model
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated about a year before the check. Last-touch attribution for most conversion types; options to credit each ad set or only the last ad set; some conversions measured with modelling for privacy.

title: LinkedIn conversion window
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated about two months before the check. Click and view windows of 1, 7, 30 or 90 days; default 90-day click and 90-day view; 180 or 365 days for some lead and purchase categories sent by Conversions API or CSV.

title: LinkedIn Conversions API
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated about three months before the check. Server-side online and offline conversions including phone sales and in-person event leads; partner or direct setup; email hashed with SHA-256; data deleted after 180 days except aggregate reporting; deduplication with the Insight Tag.

title: Revenue Attribution Report in Business Manager
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated about seven months before the check. Links CRM data from Salesforce, Dynamics 365 or HubSpot to LinkedIn ad activity; impression-based or engagement-based; member or company level; metrics include pipeline, revenue won, win rate and days to close.

title: Create and host LinkedIn Live: access criteria
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Updated about a year before the check. More than 150 followers or connections, account at least 30 days old, good standing, no application; a third-party streaming tool is required.

title: Snowflake customer story (Thought Leader Ads for Dev Day)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Vendor case study, undated; event in 2024. Thought Leader Ads as the only tactic for Snowflake's first Dev Day; 21.2% CTR; 64 sign-ups; registrations from 40 target accounts; earlier Data Cloud Summit test 5.6% CTR, 2.7x single image ads.

title: 360Suite customer story (Event Ads and LinkedIn Live)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Vendor case study, undated. Software firm of 50 to 100 staff; virtual events on LinkedIn Live promoted with Event Ads, retargeting and Lead Gen Forms; more than 2,000 registrations and 632 SQLs in six weeks; $19 per registration.

title: Understand the lead scoring tool
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dated 2 Sep 2026. Fit, engagement and combined scores for contacts and companies; negative points; score and group limits; decay every 1, 3, 6 or 12 months; Professional or Enterprise needed; AI scoring needs Marketing Hub Enterprise and 50 contacts (25 converted, 25 not).

title: Use lifecycle stages
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Dated 17 Jul 2026. Default stages Subscriber to Evangelist plus Other; automatic updates only move forward; MQL qualified by marketing, SQL by sales; lead status sub-stages.

title: HubSpot MCP server
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated (footer 2026). Remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com with OAuth; read and write for CRM objects such as contacts, companies and deals; campaigns, pages and blog posts read-only; no access to custom sensitive data properties.

title: [GA4] Get started with attribution
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. Three models: data-driven attribution, paid and organic last click, Google paid channels last click; first click, linear, time decay and position-based removed November 2023; direct visits get no credit unless the whole path is direct.

title: 2026 Webinar Benchmarks
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Published 1 Sep 2026. 33,786 sessions in 2025 from 3,199 organisations; show-up rate 47.7%; 175 registrants and 83 attendees on average; 68 minutes; 26 minutes watched; 49.7% of registrations in the final 7 days, 15.3% on the day; Tuesday highest show-up; public replays about 3.7x the views of gated.

title: CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business
supports: Opened with WebFetch. August 2023, edited January 2024. No exception for B2B email; accurate headers; honest subject; ad disclosure; postal address; opt-out honoured within 10 business days and working for 30 days; up to $53,088 per violating email; seller and sender can both be liable.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (CCPA)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. The CCPA exemptions for employee and business-to-business data expired on 31 December 2022; coverage thresholds include $26.625 million gross revenue from 1 January 2025.

title: Marketing and advertising: the law - Direct marketing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. Marketing emails and texts to individual customers need permission; every message must offer an easy opt-out; screen calls against the Telephone Preference Service; bought lists must be checked with the supplier.

title: Data (Use and Access) Act factsheet: Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Published 27 June 2025. Calls and communications count whether or not they reach the recipient; charity soft opt-in; new cookie exceptions; measures commence in stages.

title: Can data received from a third party be used for marketing?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. List supplier must show GDPR-compliant collection and permission for advertising; consent must have covered passing data on; tell people at the first communication; exclude objectors; ePrivacy Directive Article 13 for email.

title: Legal grounds for processing data
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Undated. Six legal grounds; legitimate interests can cover direct marketing after checking the person's rights and informing them; direct marketing list rules; special category data such as health.

title: La prospection commerciale par courrier électronique, SMS-MMS et automate d'appel
supports: Opened with WebFetch (French; summarised in English). Dated 10 June 2026. B2B email prospecting allowed without prior consent when it relates to the recipient's profession, provided the person was informed and can object; generic addresses such as contact@ fall outside these rules; consumers need prior consent.

title: Canada's anti-spam legislation, consolidated Act E-1.6 (sections 10 to 11)
publisher: Justice Laws Website, Government of Canada
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Implied consent: existing business relationship (two years for purchases and contracts, six months for inquiries), published or disclosed addresses with no statement refusing messages and relevance to the person's role; unsubscribe within 10 business days.

title: Canada's anti-spam legislation, consolidated Act E-1.6 (section 20, administrative monetary penalties)
publisher: Justice Laws Website, Government of Canada
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Maximum penalty of $1,000,000 for an individual and $10,000,000 for any other person.

title: Electronic Commerce Protection Regulations (SOR/2013-221)
publisher: Justice Laws Website, Government of Canada
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Last amended 15 Jan 2015. Section 3(a)(ii): messages to an employee or representative of another organisation are exempt where the organisations have a relationship and the message concerns the recipient organisation's activities.
